clauses.text: For longitudinal reinforcement in Special Moment Frames (SMF), the reinforcement ratio, ρ_g, shall not be less than 0.01 and shall not exceed 0.06.
clauses.notes:
Longitudinal reinforcement - Steel bars placed along the length of a structural member to resist bending and axial forces.
ρ_g (reinforcement ratio) - (total cross-sectional area of longitudinal reinforcement)/ (gross cross-sectional area of the member).
SMF - Special Moment Frame, a seismic-force-resisting structural system.

The minimum permissible limit of long rebar in a column is 1%
The maximum permissible limit of long rebar in a column is 6%
